judged_text: The team-staff permission check joins isTeamAdmin and isTeamOwner with '&&' even though the variable is named isTeamAdminOrOwner; since a team membership holds a single role, the admin-or-owner grant collapses to owner-only (or to nothing, if isTeamAdmin excludes OWNER). A team ADMIN who is not the booking's organizer and not an attendee receives FORBIDDEN when adding guests to their team's booking; the feature's access objective was silently narrowed from 'admins or owners' to 'owners only', and both membership queries always execute even when the first is false.

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed with `&&`: `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`. This contradicts the variable name and typical intended authorization of “admin OR owner”; it effectively requires both predicates to be true, which can narrow access (e.g., admins blocked unless `isTeamAdmin` also returns true for owners and vice-versa). Additionally, both async membership checks always execute even if the first is false. This can cause legitimate team admins (who are neither organizer nor attendee) to hit the `FORBIDDEN` path.
